ranked_findings.summary: Bulk-refund requests accepted without idempotency keys, causing duplicate refunds
evidence: corpus/logs/api_gateway_2026-05-01.log: requests with request_class=bulk-refund, idempotency_key=missing, status=accepted
corpus/timeline/incident_timeline.md: bulk refund requests accepted without idempotency keys at 10:17 UTC
corpus/tickets/TICKET-8729.md: every duplicate has request_class=bulk-refund and no idempotency key; single-refund traffic with keys did not duplicate
